usage: agentware plan add-task [-h] [--format {text,json}] [--verify VERIFY]
                               [--e2e] [--kb]
                               feature description

positional arguments:
  feature               feature slug; dir under work/
  description           task description

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --verify VERIFY       the *Verify:* command
  --e2e                 tag this as an additional [e2e] task
  --kb                  tag this as an additional [kb] task
